title: Neural scaling laws

paper.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement Neural scaling laws: fit held-out loss versus parameters data and compute; aim for loss prediction within five percent on unseen runs. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use measured-training-runs; required output: Run descriptors -> predicted held-out loss. Evaluate relative_loss_prediction_error (minimize). Fit only training runs; hold out larger compute scales. Required ablation: Fit without the irreducible-loss term and compare extrapolation error. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
